notes.title: Fully supported Mouse and Keyboard Controls
notes.content:
Players can now experience the game using keyboard controls and super accurate aiming with the cursor for the single player mode.

An issue was fixed where aim sensitivity settings for gamepad (single player and two player) were not being saved. This is now resolved. 

The journey of developing KSJoF continues!

notes.title: Update 07/27/2020
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone that has purchased and wishlisted the game! Launch week has been very exciting and it wouldn’t be without your support and feedback! 

A lot of progress was made this week thanks to feedback from players. Below is a list of updates and fixes from this week. 

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the first player could accelerate the second player’s jetpack after continuing the game.

[*] Fixed issue where bullets from the Orca weapon were colliding with the player when shooting downwards. 

[*] Fixed issue where you can fly out of the map in level 2.

[*] Fixed issue where you could reach the end of level 2 without defeating the boss.

[*] Fixed issue where loading into level 3 causes a fatal error. (Played though a few times without error. Please let me know if you encounter this again.) 

[*] Fixed issue where weapons would not switch properly after continuing the game. 

[*] Fixed issue where using the jetpack was not sending feedback to the HUD.

[*] Headshots are now a bit easier. 
[/list]

Once again, thanks so much for taking a chance on my game and helping me to make it better!
More Soon!

notes.title: Kamodo Steve: Janitor on Fire! is Released for Early Access!
notes.content:
I am excited to announce the release of[b] Kamodo Steve: Janitor on Fire! [/b]on Steam Early Access for PC. The game release includes a 10% launch discount for those who want to help make this game a fantastic experience! In addition, the game has the jetpack available in level one as a pickup in single and local two-player modes. Jetpacks will be available in the first level for the first week of launch for early adopters. After that, the jetpack will be moved to a higher level or will be available for purchase in Steve’s workshop. 

[previewyoutube=7vAlTsZSnN0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Right now, the game has three levels, with a total of eight levels slated for the first game. So, there is still much work to be done in Early Access! I would love for you to join me on this game development journey. So, please pick up the game and let’s make something awesome together!
